verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state the platform lets developers 'call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API' and detail dedicated image generation/editing (Kontext, FLUX.2) and video generation endpoints, confirming multimodal access beyond text chat on the same platform.
